analysis:
Examined all supplied documentation, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041. No concrete regression is established by this documentation-only scope; referenced runtime implementations were not supplied.

Configuration changes describe persistent verified-weight records reused during startup registration (docs/reference/configuration.md:371 head), expanded reclaimable-memory accounting (:568 head), cache-page dropping and GLM per-file verification replacing bracketing passes (:584–590 head). Integration must examine VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift and its registration callers: owner-only storage is not integrity protection against ADV-001, who owns the files. Verify that operator-modifiable records cannot establish trusted weight identity, that manifest coverage and loaded-byte binding survive races, and that failed verification prevents publication. Relevant contracts are A-004, T-012, T-027, TB-003/TB-007 and T-041's verified-weight cache binding. These are unresolved implementation questions, not observed missing controls.

The changed memory policy requires checking SystemMemory.swift and admission/KV-budget consumers for non-overlapping page accounting, bounded reservations and failure behavior. The GLM verification exception also requires tracing managed-loader reads and PageCache.drop against the actual loaded bytes.

Troubleshooting.md:86,90–91,171–198 adds an advisory doctor check and explicit administrator-applied system-wide wire limits, including persistent LaunchDaemon setup and rollback. It states the provider never invokes sudo itself; the supplied commands do not establish a privilege-boundary regression. Examine GLMWiredLimitAdvice.swift's generated plist ownership and executable paths, and ensure these settings do not bypass native memory admission. Unchanged surrounding authorization, logout, encrypted-cache and report guidance provides context but is not evidence that their implementations were reviewed. No changed wire encryption, billing or serving-authorization control is visible.
